title: mail: operator runbook section for usenet-ipfs-mail
description:
Add a section to docs/RUNBOOK.md for usenet-ipfs-mail: config file format (minimal example), startup command (--config), how to create users (manual SQL INSERT with bcrypt hash), how to point a JMAP client at the server (autoconfig URL, bearer token auth), v1 limitations (no EventSource push, no incremental changes, cannotCalculateChanges). Also document the dependency on usenet-ipfs-reader running on the same host and sharing the overview SQLite file.

Why: without deployment docs, operators cannot run the service.

Acceptance: a developer can follow the runbook from scratch to connect Fastmail app to a local usenet-ipfs-mail instance.
